description.text: Ace Trainer Rewards are Play! Pokémon's end-of-season rewards for players who reach Ace Trainer status by earning enough Championship Points in a season, in the card game, the video games or Pokémon GO. The reward card is Celebratory Fanfare, before the 2024-2025 season the end-of-season card of Japan and the rest of Asia only, here with a Play! Pokémon logo.
